description: Verbiage templates distilled from real approved patents (USPTO), funded grants (NIH/NSF SBIR), approved SBA loans + 10-K risk factors + bond prospectuses, and disciplined investment memos (Marks/Buffett/Loeb/Einhorn/Ackman/Burry). Each lane carries the canonical section structure, fill-in templates with {{placeholder}} fields the bridge engine can populate from portal kernel readings + bridgeReadings.matched[*].derivedAngles, anchor-phrase libraries that recur across real samples, and tone tests for output evaluation.

toneTests.marksQualifierRemovalTest: Remove every qualifier ("we believe," "in our view," "tend to"). Sentence should still make a definite claim. If after qualifier-removal nothing remains, it's vapor.
toneTests.buffettConcreteMetaphorTest: One concrete metaphor per page, ideally agricultural or athletic, never financial. ("One-foot hurdles," "broken-down nags," "time is the friend.")
toneTests.loebHeadlineIndictmentTest: One unmistakable image as headline indictment ("old master painting in desperate need of restoration"), followed by specific operating critiques with named executives and named programs.
toneTests.burryFalsifiableDateTest: The strongest discipline marker — commit publicly to a falsifiable date ("maximum stress during the latter half of 2007"). Makes the position re-reviewable.
toneTests.ackmanImperativeVerbsTest: When proposing operating plan: imperative-verb bullets (Fix / Accelerate / Reduce / Increase). No hedging adverbs.

engineHooks.description: How the 6 engine lanes consume verbiage templates + bridge data + portal context. Each engine lane reads (a) the matched bridge patterns on a portal, (b) the derivedAngles per matched pattern, (c) the portal's kernel readings + functionalNetwork, and (d) the relevant lane templates from this file. Output: artifact text that reads like a real approved document.
engineHooks.patentEngine: consumes bridgeReadings.matched[*].derivedAngles.patent + portal.kernelReadings + lane='patent'; fills templates.claim1Method, templates.abstract, templates.background
engineHooks.grantEngine: consumes bridgeReadings.matched[*].derivedAngles.grant + portal context + lane='grant'; fills templates.abstract4Beat (REQUIRES ≥3 quantitative anchors), templates.longTermGoal, templates.centralHypothesis, templates.aimSentence × 3
engineHooks.sbaEngine: consumes bridgeReadings.matched[*].derivedAngles.sba + portal financial data + guarantor data + lane='sba'; fills templates.borrowerSummary, templates.guarantorBackground, templates.useOfProceeds, templates.sourcesOfRepayment, templates.dscrAnalysis, templates.stressTest, templates.creditNotElsewhere, templates.creditDecisionRationale
engineHooks.investmentEngine: consumes bridgeReadings.matched[*].derivedAngles.investment + portal.kernelReadings + bridge.knownTreatments + lane='investment'; fills templates.header, templates.variantViewOpener_v1|v2|v3 (rotate), templates.catalystBlock, templates.valuationArithmetic, templates.positionSizing, templates.riskAndFalsifiability, templates.exitConditions
engineHooks.franchiseEngine: leverages sba.templates + FTC Franchise Rule disclosure structure (Item 1-23); not yet templated — pending dedicated franchise sample research
engineHooks.researchEngine: leverages grant.templates Specific Aims structure; output as Research Note format (Hypothesis / Background / Method / Expected Outcome / Falsifiability / Citations)
